description: Email the person something they asked for, through GoldSeam's one mail service, sent from Guided by AcademyOne for KSAWorks. Call it only on the person's own request, to the address they typed in this chat as their own; never a third party's address. kind is one of: resume, bio, progress_link, playlist_ready, invitation (a copy for the person), return_link; each has its own subject, header and footer. payload is the content: text, HTML, a link, or one attached file (a PDF or a Word DOCX, up to 5 MB, as base64). The first time an address is used, the service emails it one confirmation link first and answers status waiting_for_confirmation: nothing else goes to that address until the person opens the link, then call again. An address gets at most 10 emails a day and the service 200; over a limit, or for an unknown kind, an address that is not one, or an empty payload, it answers status refused with the reason. A send that could not go answers status failed with the reason. With no mail setting on the server it answers refused, "Email is not set up on this server.", and sends nothing: give the person what they asked for in the chat. The mail log records the address, the kind, who asked, the outcome and the payload's kind and size, never the payload.
